entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken. It's just... confusing. I expected more from it, you know?
I see. Could you give me an example of what you're finding difficult?
The whole menu system is hard to use. I read the user manual, but it doesn't help. I just want to do a simple thing like check my pulse history and it's three clicks deep. It's not what I wanted.
I understand, it's frustrating when a device doesn't feel intuitive. Let me just pull up your order and check the return eligibility. One moment, please.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I'm looking at our internal policy right now... and it states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
I can see here that your VeloBand was delivered 20 days ago, on December 15th. So, you're well within that 90-day window. I can go ahead and process that return for you immediately.

Happy to help. I've just authorized the return. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, you can expect a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.
You certainly will. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
